title: Remove Blockquote Header Body Gap
description: Remove the unintended vertical gap between Blockquote citation-window header chips and the body while preserving horizontal body padding and other window kinds.
summary: Removed the Blockquote-only top body inset so citation text now begins directly beneath the header chip baseline while preserving horizontal and bottom padding. Consolidated per-kind tcolorbox style selection for table, blockquote, and nested-window behavior. Added a print regression assertion. Verified the quick print test, full light/dark report template build, and ticket-local light/dark PDF renders by visual inspection.
